I fixed the float artifacts in the sales report and committed the fix as `e7255cf`. All 9 tests pass.

The report is `SalesReport` in `src/orders-api/sales_report.py`. It summed float prices directly, so `0.1 + 0.2` came out as `0.30000000000000004`. Now it:
- sums prices as `Decimal`, converting each price via `str()` so binary float error doesn't creep in;
- formats each total to cents, so `0.30` prints as `0.30`.

Two things to check:
